_comment: Defaults for application-outreach. Do not put personal data here. Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) or ~/.config/application-outreach/config.json and override what you need. The data folder is found automatically (see scripts/outreach_tools.py); set career_os_dir in a local config or $CAREER_OS_DIR only if discovery fails.

paths._comment: Relative to the Career OS data folder. The claim ledger path is also the marker used to discover that folder.

sender._signoff_comment: Names that appear alone on a sign-off line, so the validator can skip the signature.

employer_aliases._comment: Optional extra spellings per ledger employer, e.g. {"Example Corp": ["example", "exampleco"]}. Employer names themselves are read from the ledger.

linkedin._account_note_limit_comment: Set to 200 for a free LinkedIn account (third-party trackers report 200 characters and about 5 noted invites per month; LinkedIn has not confirmed). null = unknown: enforce 300, warn above 200.

voice_style._comment: All voice checks are WARNINGS with suggestions, never blocks. Each entry should trace to a stated preference or a measured voice trait.

subject_dropped_openers.Would you be open: "I'd welcome a short conversation if you have time."
subject_dropped_openers.Open to: "I'd be glad to talk if you're open to it."

style_flags.excited: Manufactured enthusiasm. Say what interests you instead.
style_flags.thrilled: Manufactured enthusiasm. Say what interests you instead.
style_flags.passionate: Manufactured enthusiasm. Demonstrate it with the work instead.
